eventDetail.eventTitle: 2026 Conference on Robotics, Intelligent Computing and Automation (RAIC)
eventDetail.about: Computing and Processing; Robotics and Control Systems
eventDetail.sponsors: IEEE Systems, Man, and Cybernetics Society; North Minzu University
eventDetail.keywords: Cyber-Physical Systems,Intelligent Systems,Human-Machine Systems,Robotics and Automation,Systems Engineering,
eventDetail.scope: RAIC 2026 is designed to showcase advances in robotics, automation, and intelligent computing, with emphasis on their integration into cyber-physical and intelligent systems. The conference covers robotic perception, learning, navigation, manipulation, autonomous systems, collaborative robotics, swarm intelligence, and human-robot interaction. It also highlights machine learning, reinforcement learning, computer vision, sensor fusion, and intelligent decision-making for adaptive systems. In addition, RAIC 2026 focuses on automation and systems engineering, including industrial automation, intelligent manufacturing, digital twins, cyber-physical production systems, system modeling, optimization, and control theory. Special attention is given to intelligent control, multi-agent systems, edge intelligence, and networked systems. The conference aims to provide an international platform for interdisciplinary research on intelligent, autonomous, and human-centered cyber-physical systems.
